http/internal/http2_headers#

Header blocks on the wire: HEADERS followed by CONTINUATION frames, read and written as one block.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Header blocks on the wire: HEADERS followed by CONTINUATION frames, read and written as one block.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

object Http2HeaderBlockReading#

object Http2HeaderBlockReading

Connection reader owns ordering and transport; this collaborator consumes exactly one already-started HEADERS block, with no interleaved frame allowed.

Reads the block first starts, from origin, with payloads up to 16384 bytes.

object Http2HeaderBlockWriting#

object Http2HeaderBlockWriting

Caller serializes whole header blocks with other connection output. Per-frame AsyncWriting serialization alone cannot prevent two blocks from interleaving.
